name: encoding-reflection-argument-literals
description: An encoder's argument that is a composite literal reaches the type of each value the literal writes into an interface-typed position, a map value and a slice element among them, at any depth of the literals it nests, so those types keep the exported fields the program writes. A field of such a type nothing writes holds no value the program gave it, so it is reported as an unused member though the type is encoded. A value written into an interface-typed position of a literal no encoder is handed reaches nothing, so a field only that literal writes is reported as written and never read.
